metadata.memory_scope: Live named Python buffers plus native encoded/scales/workspace allocation requests; excludes cuSOLVER/cuBLAS internal allocations, allocator cache and temporary Python expression high-watermark; not physical peak

input_integrity.scope: Full host/device input fingerprints outside service timers; inter-request spacing includes validation, not a cold-system or unchanged-spacing claim

timing_contract.resident: CUDA events around complete GPU centering/scaling/transpose/encoding/products/accumulation/symmetrization/eigh. Current FP32 observations already on device. Python launch gaps and GPU-status checks are inside; output D2H and validation are outside.
timing_contract.host_service: Python wall time: current FP32 observations copied into the adapter host witness buffer, pageable H2D, all complete uncaptured GPU computation/synchronization and full mean/covariance/eigenvalues/eigenvectors D2H. Hashes/quality/serialization and dataset generation are outside.
timing_contract.setup: Constructor includes host-original copy, source H2D, named allocations/native workspace and heuristic calibration; first operation/JIT is separate. Common process/library bootstrap is separately recorded in environment, not a cold-start-free claim.
timing_contract.retention: Complete means, covariances, eigenvalues and leading16 eigenvectors retained and every observation bound. All eigenvectors computed/transferred but no unretained full-basis correctness claim. Full uniform-small Gram witnesses; elsewhere stage source/encoding hashes, all diagonal plus sampled Gram entries and complete final covariance.
